collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog shall obtain a license annually and cause the dog to be registered, numbered, described and licensed with the Township as soon as the dog has attained the age of 6 months. Dog tags shall be worn at all times.
dog_limit: No person shall own, harbour or keep more than 5 dogs unless in a licensed kennel.
notes: A standard animal control bylaw recently adopted in January 2025. It prohibits owners from allowing their dogs to run at large, bark or howl, or cause a nuisance. lgd_definition: “Livestock Guardian Dog” means a dog that works and/or lives with domestic farm animals (i.e. cattle, sheep, goats) to protect them while aggressively repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose;
collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog that has reached the age of 28 weeks or domestic cat in an urban area shall make application to register the animal with the City for either an annual or lifetime tag within 30 days of acquisition. Every tag that is issued shall be kept securely fixed on the animal at all times when the animal is in a place other than the place of its owner.
dog_limit: Not specified in the retrieved bylaw text.
notes: Very farm-friendly bylaw. It explicitly defines 'Livestock Guardian Dog' and the City's licensing fee schedule grants Livestock Guardian Dogs a complete fee exemption (free licensing, with proof). It also contains broad definitions to prevent standard animal enclosure rules from impeding on normal farm practices and livestock enclosures. URL: https://pub-kawarthalakes.escribemeetings.com/filestream.ashx?DocumentId=54153

collar_tag_req: Annual dog licence required; tag must be worn on the collar.
dog_limit: Permitted to keep a total of no more than six (6) domestic pets (dogs and cats combined) in a residential dwelling, with a maximum of three (3) dogs over the age of twenty (20) weeks.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw. Barking is also regulated under Noise By-law 1190. URL: https://www.marathon.ca/media/snsf4srh/1788-regulate-govern-animals-2.pdf

lgd_definition: Guardian Dog means a type of pastoral dog bred for the purpose of protecting livestock from predators.
collar_tag_req: The owner shall be required to provide each dog with a collar or harness to which the license tag must be permanently affixed.
dog_limit: No person or persons shall own, harbour or keep more than three (3) domesticated household dogs on a lot. Because 'Guardian Dogs' are defined separately from 'Domesticated Household Dogs' (which are kept for companionship), the 3-dog limit functionally exempts Guardian Dogs.
notes: Farm friendly! Mapleton's by-law explicitly defines 'Guardian Dog' as a pastoral dog bred for protecting livestock, which separates them from 'Domesticated Household Dogs' and their corresponding limits. URL: https://www.mapleton.ca/media/pnxnffap/2019-034-dog-by-law-canine.pdf
